data.name: SupplyHelp
data.value: Supply this container, preserving existing contents and declared initialization.

data.name: ClearHelp
data.value: Omit this answer. A string list item is reset to an empty string; use Remove item to remove its row.

data.name: ResetHelp
data.value: Remove the override and omission so declared initialization can apply. This does not copy an initialized value into supplied answers.

data.name: ImportLimitHelp
data.value: Local input, at most 4 MiB. Compare leaves current answers, drafts and prepared output untouched. Fill fields is deliberate and atomic.

data.name: ImportFactsFormat
data.value: Artifact: {0} | Compatibility: {1} | Execution completed: {2} | Coverage complete: {3} | Finding inventory complete: {4} | File eligible for autofill: {5}

data.name: ImportAdoptionFormat
data.value: Current workspace adoption: {0}. Target acceptance is unassessed. No historical rename, release or deployment provenance is established.

data.name: ImportSchemaHelp
data.value: Declared schema guidance only. This never selects or corrects a current row or map entry. Repair a separate copy of the imported file, or deliberately resolve workspace conflicts before filling fields.

data.name: SecretCopied
data.value: Copied to the system clipboard. Clipboard history may retain this value.

data.name: SecretClipboardUnavailable
data.value: The clipboard is unavailable. Your value is still in this workspace.

data.name: SecretCancelled
data.value: Generation was cancelled or superseded by an edit.

data.name: SecretOperationFailed
data.value: The secret operation could not complete. Check the declared requirements and try again.

data.name: InvalidValue
data.value: A valid value is required. Check the declared type and constraints.

data.name: BundleOutputs
data.value: Bundle outputs (select one or more declared files)

data.name: ImportPath
data.value: Existing file to import for the selected artifact

data.name: StayOpenHelp
data.value: Withdraw the close request while native work remains owned and cancellation stays requested.

data.name: ForceCloseHelp
data.value: Close despite an unknown native outcome. This cannot guarantee no write, rollback or managed memory erasure.

data.name: PublicationHelp
data.value: Historical installation, verification and cleanup facts do not restore preparation or guarantee current file integrity.

data.name: StatusGeneral
data.value: Local preparation does not apply configuration to the target application.

data.name: StatusDefinitionRequired
data.value: Choose a local JSON or YAML definition, then load it.

data.name: StatusDefinitionInvalid
data.value: Check the local definition and its supported format, size and permissions, then load it again.

data.name: StatusValidationInvalid
data.value: Correct the marked fields, then validate or prepare again.

data.name: StatusPreparationInvalid
data.value: Correct the answers or select active declared outputs, then prepare again.

data.name: StatusSelectionUnavailable
data.value: Native selection is unavailable. Enter a local path and use the adjacent action.

data.name: StatusSelectionNonlocal
data.value: Choose a file or folder on this computer; remote locations are not accepted.

data.name: StatusImportUnreadable
data.value: Check the existing file and its permissions, then retry the import.

data.name: StatusImportUnsupported
data.value: Select an artifact with a supported unambiguous inverse mapping, then retry the import.

data.name: StatusAnswerConflict
data.value: Resolve conflicting current answers before retrying the whole import.

data.name: StatusInputInvalid
data.value: Correct the existing file's format and declared field values, then retry the whole import.

data.name: StatusSaveFailed
data.value: Check host protection, the existing destination and file conflicts; prepare again before retrying.

data.name: StatusSaveInstalledUnverified
data.value: Installation occurred, but verification did not succeed. Inspect the destination manually; its current contents are not guaranteed. Keep existing files and use a fresh destination before retrying.

data.name: StatusSaveInstalledVerified
data.value: Installation was verified, but cleanup failed. Keep the file and review the cleanup problem; retrying cannot overwrite it.

data.name: StatusBundleSavePartial
data.value: Keep installed files and inspect unverified destinations manually. Select only failed or unattempted outputs, resolve the problem and prepare again using fresh destinations.

data.name: StatusCancelled
data.value: Preparation was discarded. Prepare current answers again when ready.

data.name: StatusInputsChanged
data.value: Validate and prepare the current answers before saving.

data.name: ClosePending
data.value: Waiting for the native consumer and cleanup. Cancellation does not prove that nothing was written.

data.name: CloseUnknown
data.value: The native operation has not settled. Its outcome is unknown. Stay open to keep waiting, or deliberately force close. Force close cannot guarantee no write or managed memory erasure.

data.name: ProtectedSaveAvailable
data.value: Protected create-only save is available on this host.

data.name: ProtectedSaveUnavailable
data.value: Protected save is unavailable on this host; prepared output cannot be saved here.

data.name: ArtifactConsequences
data.value: Format: {0} | apply: {1} | restart: {2} Restricted output. Save creates a new owner-only file; it never overwrites or applies it.

data.name: PublicationReview
data.value: Current integrity is not guaranteed; review the destination manually.
